auditNotes.zeroCoverageRootCause: isEnabled=false in DB — site is parked/never enabled. crawlPhase=bootstrap, bootstrapStartedAt=null, 0 products. NOT a technical blocker: the DB siteProfile (catalogUrls/pagination/sort) is largely sound and uses brand+type leaves to avoid the tile-only /firearms/ and /knives/ parents. The catalog is plainly fetchable via static HTTP (no Playwright). Enabling the site should start indexing.
auditNotes.secondaryBlockerIfEnabled: DB catalogUrls contains 2 DEAD (404) knives URLs: /knives/browning-4908428/ and /knives/boker-4908434/ (numeric-ID forms no longer resolve; live forms are /knives/browning/ and /knives/boker/). Runtime break-on-zero would skip those two brands. Fixed in this candidate.
auditNotes.parentTileTrap: B15 confirmed: /firearms/ and /knives/ parents return HTTP 200 + 0 products via .product-element (subcategory/brand-tile hubs). But /ammunition/, /optics/, /accessories/, /reloading/, /field-gear/, /maintenance-storage/, /excalibur-archery/ parents DO render 24 products + pageN.html — parent behavior is NON-UNIFORM on this site.
auditNotes.perPageCorrection: RESOLVED in favor of DB=100. Lightspeed eCom HONORS ?limit but CAPS at 100: ?limit=100 returns exactly 100 cards on /ammunition/ and /optics/; ?limit=250 is rejected and falls back to the 24 default (this caused an initial mis-read in this R1 run that ?limit was ignored). perPage=100 is correct. NOTE: <link rel=next> still points to pageN.html regardless of limit, so the suffix-replace template bakes in ?limit=100&sort=newest. Cross-checked against prior B6R2 audit which independently verified ?limit=100 -> 100 cards.
auditNotes.expectedCountCorrection: DB expectedProductCount=3770 / totalSiteProductCount=3577. Live sitemap.xml product .html count = 3876 (filter for .html locs). Re-derived to 3876. Drift vs DB ~2.8%.
auditNotes.catalogOverlapNeedsWalk: INCONCLUSIVE under gentle R1: DB included BOTH firearms brand leaves (~40) AND type leaves. This candidate switches firearms to the TYPE-leaf tree (centerfire/rimfire/shotguns/combination/muzzleloading/lever-action/surplus/pellet-pal) for minimal overlap. Coverage of the type-leaf set vs brand-leaf set vs sitemap NOT walk-verified (would need hundreds of page fetches). Operator/R2 must walk-and-dedup to confirm the type-leaf tree reaches 100% of firearms before dropping the brand leaves.
